author: iDarkBlazeMC
body:
Hello, my name is Ron and i would like to say that i was banned unfairly from the avicus network.My username is iDarkBlazeMC and i was banned for Anti-Knockback on Nebula. First i would like to say that i was actually not hacking! i am really telling the truth and the reason the respective mod banned me was probably from the lag which i get usually a lot on any server as I live in India and the location here is very far away from the US. I was banned about 10 mins ago(before i post this) and this was truly unfair. I am pretty sure that you did not expect me to be recording at the time of my ban. https://gyazo.com/ae3536a3431adf9bb83eb005780a8a52 . That is the message I get from the server when i try to join. 
The reason I should be unbanned: I am 100% sure that i was lagging and that might be a big reason why I was banned and I think I should not be banned for 'LAG'. Plus this server is really addicting and I would never hack on a server especially this one
I hope you take this matter seriously and hopefully unban me.
Thanks
-Ron
